svg.title: Companion editing and banks
svg.desc: Edit visually, audition locally and choose explicit unit destinations.

g.text: Edit visually, audition locally and choose explicit unit destinations.
Sliders, musical selectors and a gesture-level Undo support detailed editing.
64 DEFAULT and 64 USER PC slots are separate from hardware storage until transferred.
Opening a unit instrument preserves the editor arrangement; loading a project replaces it.
Actual Companion browser capture / example library / no unit connected
